:::info Planned functionality
The workflow and data model are under discussion. The sequence below is a
documentation outline and does not define the normative TARA process.
:::

The user guide will explain how to describe the assessment context, enter and
maintain assessment information, record decisions and their reasoning, and
review results with other authorised users.

Each implemented operation should be documented with its prerequisites, exact
UI steps, expected result, and relevant validation or error messages. Assessment
methods and terminology must be reviewed by the team responsible for the
ISO/SAE 21434 mapping before they are presented as authoritative guidance.

Related topics: [sharing](sharing.md), [import/export](import-export.md),
and [TARA context](../concepts/tara.md).
